name: ship-feature
description: End-to-end feature delivery conductor: one feature from rough idea to merged, cross-family-verified production code by conducting the shipyard stages - intake, triage, plan in parallel with design, work, the deferred loop, gap-fix, acceptance-e2e, verify (the only path to Done), and a fail-closed merge with a decided-in-advance rollback. Holds the thread in-session, defers decisions through the second-opinion lanes instead of stalling on questions, and treats every stage artifact as the resumable memory.
